name: GNU-Darwin Aqua
direction: Panther/Tiger Aqua: cool pale pinstripes, brushed silver headers, glossy blue controls, left traffic lights, a continuous light top panel and centered bottom dock.
source_concept: User-selected GNU-Darwin for Darwin 7/8 and Mac OS X 10.3/10.4; source colour samples and attribution in identity/source-samples.json and BRIEF.md.

typography.verification: Liberation Sans and Liberation Mono confirmed by fc-list 2026-09-29. Installed substitutes; no Apple fonts copied.

geometry.panel_groups: panel1:left exact existing menu label; panel1:right status and calendar; panel2:center grouped-window-list only. No center clock island.
geometry.geometry_note: 34px continuous top bar and 68px transparent bottom panel actor; only its center zone paints the dock body. Top icons 20px; dock icons 44px. Values are logical pixels; verify at native display scale.
geometry.composition: A continuous opaque pinstriped menu bar anchors the top. Status and clock align right, without floating islands. The bottom full-width panel actor is transparent; a compact silver rounded center-zone dock wraps only its launchers. Window headers are brushed silver with centered dark titles and left circular close/minimize/maximize controls. White file/content panes contrast with pale pinstriped utility canvases. Glossy capsule actions and narrow blue selection rows replace the lineage dark floating polycarbonate composition.

materials.text_surfaces: Opaque light canvases and popovers. Main file/editor content may use elevated. GTK prefer-dark false and color-scheme prefer-light.
materials.shadow: Neutral black 20% alpha, 0px 3px 9px window shadow; no coloured glow.
materials.texture: 2px pale horizontal pinstripes on empty utility chrome only, alternating background #EEF0F2 and #E2E4E7. Brushed header strokes at <=5% contrast. Keep text panes untextured. Silver gloss from #F8F9FA to #E2E4E7; no dark trough behind text.
materials.motion: Existing short Cinnamon transitions; no flashing default button or dock magnification required.
materials.wallpaper: Original 2880x1800 blue flowing waves inspired by sampled #265098, #5692BF and #649BC8; quiet central negative space, original GNU-Darwin wordmark. No copied Apple wallpaper.
materials.gloss: Primary control glossy cap stays at upper 20% outside label area; label area stays selection #245FA8, white text. Decorative accent #4384D6 only where no text overlaps.

artwork.source: Original vectors/raster generation by desktop builder. Historical screenshots in identity/ are reference-only, never installed; Apple UI content belongs to its respective rights holders.
artwork.instruction: Generate wallpaper.png 2880x1800 with original blue wave paths and GNU-Darwin text, original GD monogram menu-logo.png and plymouth-logo.png; no invented official GNU-Darwin or Apple logo. Preserve original Fastfetch art. Boot builder reuses staged original wallpaper with high-contrast opaque UI panels.

preserve: Exact existing menu label le cinabon (current handoff overrides older cinabon baseline)
Current Carbon Typewriter host selection during staging
Custom shell and music commands and all mixed MPV/Cava behavior settings
Fastfetch original art, short and long modes, plain fastfetch stays short, custom Local IP 86.75-309
All other preset state and receipts including GNUOS NT and Lavender Glass
GRUB timeout owned by 98_mintsysadm.cfg, EFI loaders, autologin and PAM
Unrelated application settings and personal documents
verification: Staged only. Build, configuration, isolated screenshots, interaction and real boot/login evidence must be tracked independently. No host activation or root install is authorized by this design.

semantic_rules.small_accent_text: Accent #4384D6 is fill-only: decorative glossy cap, icon colour and progress fill; never small text on light surfaces. Use secondary #265098 for links and accent-coloured text.
semantic_rules.primary_buttons: Selection #245FA8 with white selection_foreground for labels. Keep entire label region solid selection; glossy cap may occupy only the upper 20% outside the text area. Hover darkens to secondary #265098 with white labels. Selected menus/rows are selection with white text, including GTK and Cinnamon overrides.
semantic_rules.borders: control_border for essential input/control outlines and focus token for 2px focus ring. border is decorative only. No inherited dark translucent background may sit behind light-theme dark text.
semantic_rules.secondary: Secondary, success, warning and error are text-safe on all three light canvases. Pair status text with an icon/word, not colour alone.
semantic_rules.rainbow: Six blues for original GD monogram/waves only; not an Apple mark and not status semantics.
semantic_rules.ansi_black: Slot 0 dark ink; slot 8 muted dark gray. All sixteen inks are legible on the light terminal. White ANSI slots intentionally map to darker neutral ink on this light scheme; applications forcing ANSI backgrounds require visual checking.
semantic_rules.states: Normal dark text/light fill; hover surface fill and foreground; selected selection/white; focused 2px focus; disabled disabled ink (not opacity-reduced); urgent error with light background and visible symbol. Inactive titles muted, active titles foreground. Modal dialogs elevated opaque. Traffic lights red #A52925, amber #805200, green #276235 with visible white #FFFFFF glyphs on hover; decorative highlights cannot erase button outlines. Traffic-light glyph contrast: white/error 7.13:1; white/warning 6.72:1; white/success 7.28:1.
semantic_rules.light_preference: GTK gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=false, org.cinnamon.desktop.interface color-scheme=prefer-light; GTK/CSD title labels dark; explicit light variants for app palettes.
semantic_rules.transparency: All text-bearing panel, popup, dock and application surfaces opaque. Only empty bottom panel actor is transparent; dock body is opaque surface. Wallpaper and shadows are decorative.
semantic_rules.contrast: foreground/background 13.80:1; foreground/surface 12.37:1; foreground/elevated 14.95:1; muted/background 6.10:1; muted/surface 5.47:1; muted/elevated 6.61:1; disabled/background 3.79:1; disabled/surface 3.40:1; disabled/elevated 4.10:1; accent/background 3.34:1; accent/surface 2.99:1; accent/elevated 3.62:1; secondary/background 6.85:1; secondary/surface 6.14:1; secondary/elevated 7.42:1; focus/background 5.61:1; focus/surface 5.03:1; focus/elevated 6.08:1; control_border/background 3.79:1; control_border/surface 3.40:1; control_border/elevated 4.10:1; success/background 6.37:1; success/surface 5.71:1; success/elevated 6.91:1; warning/background 5.88:1; warning/surface 5.28:1; warning/elevated 6.38:1; error/background 6.24:1; error/surface 5.60:1; error/elevated 6.77:1; selection_foreground/selection 6.41:1; terminal_foreground/terminal 14.95:1; top_foreground/top_background 13.80:1; island_foreground/island_background 12.37:1. Accent is fill-only; all other small text >=4.5:1, disabled/focus/control_border >=3:1.

panel_layout.comment: Exact two-panel layout: continuous top menu/status bar, transparent bottom actor with centered dock body. Allocate new calendar from current next-applet-id. Preserve exact menu label le cinabon. All removed applet files are journaled before relocation.
panel_layout.restore: Restore removed multi-instance settings files byte-exact before restoring panels-height, panels-enabled, enabled-applets, full zone arrays, and desklets from the journal. Remove only the newly created calendar settings file after the original layout is restored. Preserve the monotonic next-applet-id. Restore menu icon state through the menu adapter receipt after panel restoration.
